headline: Specialized and archival biological databases expand coverage and consolidate annotation
label: Biological Database Infrastructure
summary: Five database reports span RNA structures, tRNA, viral structures, ERVs and INSDC, pairing content growth with unified, sustained curation and governance.
synthesis: The common thread is the maintenance and expansion of curated public biological resources. RR3DD 2.0 grows RNA 3D structure classification to 15,764 chains in 1,042 RMscore clusters mapped to Rfam. tRNAdb 2026 extends a tRNA sequence and gene compilation that originated from Sprinzl's collection. BFVD v3 offers ColabFold-AlphaFold2-predicted viral protein structures, and ERV Navigator integrates human endogenous retrovirus annotations, nomenclatures and loci into one phylogenetically informed reference. INSDC reports an archive exceeding 75 PB, with new governance, a membership pathway and planned AI-assisted metadata work. The new element is consolidation: unified nomenclature and classification in domain resources, and governance and metadata planning at archive scale. The items are heterogeneous; the thread applies most directly to the domain-specific resources.
